about: What Grain adds to the CPU meter (percent), each pair the same Part with the track on Flex and then Grain. resources.cpuMeter is the largest difference, rounded up: 16.55 -> 17. Figures are medians of the side-first runs, or the middle five of seven 1-second health readings (per mille) where readings are given.
